title: The proof walk - each episode's card at its date

members.role: the episode's stretch of the long line lights on its word - the light travels it (T36)
the episode's year becomes an accent pill on the x axis - the era named where it stands (T9)
the episode's card reads in the plot's empty room, then parks to a chip at its date with a leader - the join IS the claim
the episode's number is written at its datum as the card parks (T20's check or cross where it is a verdict)

does: One long line walks its episodes: each stretch lights, its year is tagged on the axis, its card reads in the plot's empty room and parks to its date with a leader, its number is written - one episode per sentence.

use_when.act: SPANS - one long line proves a pattern by walking its episodes (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN R4)
use_when.use: one long line proves a pattern by walking its episodes, each with its card (R4; BUB 7:22, RST 07:22-08:22 'the credit market began flashing warning signs')
use_when.dont: a card would read over the plot (E63: it reads in the plot's empty room and parks to a chip - over the ink only by the author's `under`, s124 (3)); one episode per sentence, never two cards reading at once

source: P71 T23 (harvest v2 R4, n=1; BRAVOS-USE-WHEN :931). Its park_at member is pinned by the goldens card-reads-in-the-empty-room and card-parks-at-its-date; the whole walk is proved as a private TEST-BED beat on H row 9's railway page (P71 T23 frames/, labelled as one); no approved cut carries it
